visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a modern living room with white walls. A man in a black tank top is seated on the floor in the foreground, while a woman and two young boys are seated on a large grey sofa in the background. A small wooden coffee table sits between them. (2) The man stands up abruptly, holding a white electric mosquito swatter. He moves toward a window covered with grey curtains, looking for something. The children watch him with curiosity from the sofa. (3) Suddenly, the man begins swinging the swatter frantically. A small dark object is seen flying through the air. The woman screams and runs across the room, exiting and re-entering the frame. The camera moves rapidly to follow the action. (4) The man successfully catches the insect. He holds the swatter up to the camera, showing a large dark cockroach stuck to the mesh. He then shows it to the children, who look at it with a mix of fear and interest. The setting remains the same indoor living room.
